title: Unique Bitter Jamaican Teque Nos Stew
description: A diabetic-friendly Jamaican stew featuring pre-fried teque nos, slow-cooked to perfection with a blend of bitter and energizing flavors, served on a lazy-susan-spinner for a fun dining experience. This dish is perfect for those looking for a unique and healthy meal option.
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a large pot over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pot and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the pre-fried teque nos, bitter melon, scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir well.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a lazy-susan-spinner to serve the stew, allowing each guest to help themselves.
Garnish with fresh thyme and scotch bonnet peppers, if desired.
Serve hot and enjoy the unique flavors and textures of this Jamaican stew.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
